subject: ClarifyPoint: tenant-specific log hold and deletion evidence request
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@claritypoint.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@claritypoint.com, Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@claritypoint.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Tenant-specific log hold request and evidence needed

Hi Karthik,

Quick context: we're in the middle of a regulatory review and a small subset of our tenants (3 production tenants) need their activity and telemetry logs preserved for 18 months instead of your default 90-day TTL. This is a temporary legal hold tied to case CP-2026-43.

Can you share:
- A concise artifact that demonstrates how Redwood would isolate and retain logs for only those tenants (scope definition).
- Proof that retained logs remain immutable/read-only for the hold period.
- An outline of deletion/erase playbooks used once the hold is lifted (e.g., proof-of-delete steps).
- Any SIG/CAIQ control mappings that are relevant to data retention and proof of deletion.

We're on a tight timeline — would appreciate a cleared evidence packet by end of week (Jan 22). If you need a conference call to go through technical details, happy to set one up.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Security & Compliance
ClarityPoint Health

[Attachment: legal_hold_notice.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@claritypoint.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant-specific log hold request and evidence needed

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Looping in Naomi (Security Evidence), Monica (SRE/retention), and Priyom (Legal ops) to assemble a scoped evidence pack.

Planned deliverables by Jan 22:
- retention_matrix.xlsx (shows tenant identifiers, exact artifacts retained, retention window)
- proof_of_delete_playbook.pdf (step-by-step playbook + audit checklist)
- s3-lifecycle-policy.json (example lifecycle policy and immutable config we would apply)
- SIG/CAIQ excerpt mapping (controls related to logging/retention)

A few clarifying questions so we scope minimally:
1) Please confirm the three tenant IDs (tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c is fine as placeholders) and whether you want retained logs stored in a separate customer-scoped bucket or tagged in our existing debug bucket.
2) Do you require cryptographic tamper-evidence (WORM/HSM/KMS attestation) or is an immutable S3 object lock combined with access ACLs sufficient?

Naomi/Priyo/Monica — can you confirm who will own each artifact? I can draft the cover letter for their risk/compliance team once we have attachments.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

> Quick context: we're in the middle of a regulatory review and a small subset of our tenants (3 production tenants) need their activity and telemetry logs preserved for 18 months instead of your default 90-day TTL...

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-19T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Tenant-specific log hold request and evidence needed

Karthik — attaching the artifacts I pulled together. Monica verified the lifecycle policy and confirmed we can apply a tenant-scoped retention policy without impacting other customers.

Attachments included here (also uploaded to drive):
- retention_matrix.xlsx (tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c mapping + retention window + who owns each artifact)
- proof_of_delete_playbook.pdf (playbook draft, includes verification checklist and audit log entries to capture)
- s3-lifecycle-policy.json (example; note: object-lock mode + governance retention used for the hold)

Notes:
- For cryptographic attestation: current plan is S3 Object Lock (governance mode) + KMS-backed keys; we can extend to WORM/HSM if customers explicitly require it but that adds provisioning lead time.
- We will create a scoped bucket per-tenant and apply a read-only policy to the security team role; SRE will create a timebound cross-account role for ClarityPoint read-only access if requested.

I've added the drive link and JIRA ticket for tracking: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/claritypoint-evidence and JIRA SEC-1248.

-naomi
Security Evidence Lead
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: retention_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: proof_of_delete_playbook.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: s3-lifecycle-policy.json (json)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@claritypoint.com>, Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@claritypoint.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-20T14:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant-specific log hold request and evidence needed — evidence packet and next steps

Hi Lydia / Michael,

Thanks for the patience — attached is the evidence packet for the three tenants you identified (tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c). Summary below and next steps.

What we provided in the attachment bundle:
- retention_matrix.xlsx: explicit scope mapping (which identifiers/data types are retained per tenant), retention window (18 months as requested), and owner contact for each artifact.
- proof_of_delete_playbook.pdf: the exact erase workflow we will run once the hold is lifted, including verification hashes and an independent audit step.
- s3-lifecycle-policy.json: sample policy using S3 Object Lock (governance), KMS key id (redwood-kms-01) and lifecycle rules to transition/archive then expire post-hold.
- SIG/CAIQ excerpt: controls mapping to CAIQ data retention/deletion questions (we included control IDs in the drive link).

Operations note: Monica (cc'd) will schedule the tenant-scoped bucket creation and apply governance retention by Jan 23; Naomi will seed the evidence artifacts and export an audit snapshot to your drive link. Priyom will provide a short legal letter confirming Redwood's authority and chain-of-custody for deletion actions.

Proposed timeline:
- Jan 23: Scoped buckets live + governance retention applied
- Jan 23–25: Evidence snapshot and initial verification (we'll share audit entries)
- After hold lift (you provide formal release): we will execute proof_of_delete_playbook, provide proof-of-delete artifacts within 7 calendar days and log entries in the shared drive.

If you want a 30-minute walkthrough of the artifacts and policies, we can book time Tues/Thu next week.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: retention_matrix.xlsx, proof_of_delete_playbook.pdf, s3-lifecycle-policy.json]
